_meta.description: Product-intent confirmation record (owner brief requirement, 2026-11-17). For each submitted link it stores the intended ASIN, the official listing URL, the confirmation date and the source (the 'intent' block). Observed redirect targets are stored in the separate 'observed_redirect' block and are never merged into the intent fields.
_meta.rule: Do not merge the two fields. The intent is what the owner wants to promote: a stable identifier confirmed against the official listing page. The observed redirect is a dated observation of what a fetch saw; observations drift between reads (F-29, F-44) and are never copied into the intent block. Rationale: Amazon's ASIN definition provides a checkable identifier (data/sources.json S-ASIN).

tracking_id.recorded_as: The Associate ID (tag) carried by every constructed Special Link on this site. Enrollment of this tag in the amazon.com Associates programme cannot be verified from this workspace and is confirmed only by the account holder (Q-46, F-03).

_meta.special_link_form: https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>?tag=shopnow047c-20&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 - the canonical product-URL form with the tag= parameter required of Special Links (Program Policies, Participation Requirements 2(b); data/sources.json S-POL). Destination tested per link on 2026-11-17; attribution confirmation in Associates Central reports is the owner's gate before scaling.
